title: Hard Hat Weather: the plow call, the night before
say: LaPorte Weather Now dot com slash hard hat

sources.what: Snow & ice calls for plow crews around 6 PM, 3 AM update; per-lot storm record from NOAA's National Snowfall Analysis; free for one site; Crew $19/mo; rain-out guarantee; JOIN by text
LaPorte averages more than 60 inches of snow a year (the site's own winter pages and NWS normals)
sources.who: La Porte Weather Now; NWS Northern Indiana

beats.text: If you plow lots in LaPorte County, your winter starts at 6 PM, not 3 AM.
beats.label: FOR PLOW AND SALT CREWS
beats.credit: Hard Hat Weather, by La Porte Weather Now

beats.text: Hard Hat Weather texts you the night before snow or ice: plow, salt, or watch, with the inches, the hours, and the low, for every lot you name.
beats.label: 6 PM, THE NIGHT BEFORE

beats.text: If it gets worse overnight, a 3 AM update. On a quiet night, no message at all.
beats.label: 3 AM, ONLY IF IT CHANGES

beats.text: And the morning after, a dated record for each lot: how much fell, when, and what you were told. For per-push billing, and the slip-and-fall question that comes in March.
beats.label: THE MORNING AFTER

card.label: EVERY LOT, EVERY STORM
card.note: WHEN IT FELL, WHAT WE SAID

beats.credit: Snow totals from NOAA's National Snowfall Analysis

beats.text: It's free for one lot. A whole crew is 19 dollars a month. Sign up at laporteweathernow.com/hardhat before the first snow.
